newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Putnam sells Syd Casino stake - source. [CORRECTED 02:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Putnam sells Syd Casino stake - source. [CORRECTED 02:05 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear that, according to a market source, Putnam sold, rather than acquired, a stake)

U.S. fund manager Putnam Investments was believed to have sold most of the 26.51 million shares in Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd which dominated early trade last Thursday, market sources told Reuters on Monday.
The shares represent about 6.8 percent of the issued capital in the casino, which is now located at a temporary site in inner Sydney.
While the identity of the buyer was not revealed, sources said most of the stock was bought by local institutions.
